headline: Ask for a model family, get its newest live model
share: AnyRouter 1.6: send a -latest id such as google/gemini-flash-latest and the newest live model in that family answers. Also in 1.6: BYOK keys replaced in place, a read-only read:analytics scope, GPT-6.1 Sol and Step 5 Preview.
rationale: -latest aliases change what you put in the model field, so they lead. BYOK replacement and the client-disconnect fix change day-to-day operation; new models and the analytics scope follow; the SLM Matrix closes. The site redesign is left out: nothing a developer calls. Six highlights need 40s to read; the at-a-glance checklist would only repeat all six and still did not fit at 52s, so it is left out.
